items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Herschel Evans; the interviewer mentions hearing Herschel Evans in the context of the Kansas City Blue Devils.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, and the Honey Coles and them?

Well, that was really something, that was a program. You know I went to the Apollo -- well, I used to go to the Lafayette and I used to go to the Harlem Opera House and Frank Schiffman -- you see the Apollo used to be a burlesque house. Frank Schiffman took it over -- I don't know whether it's '34 or '35 and I went there for about four years and I missed about five shows in about four years. I saw Count Basie when he came back with the old Benny Morton band, the old Benny Morton brothers. Benny and Al died and…
